runtime_gltf.limit: No GLTFDocument/State/extensions or runtime glTF/GLB import/export. Ordinary editor-exported scenes remain intended, pending build/runtime verification.

runtime_fbx.limit: No FBXDocument/State or runtime FBX import/export; FBX depends on gltf in this source.

runtime_convex_decomposition.limit: No runtime VHACD, multiple convex collision generation or simplified convex creation that needs decomposition. Existing exported shapes remain intended.

webxr.limit: No WebXR interface; does not disable all 3D or XR core.

enet.limit: No ENet classes/API. Current web NetSocket already lacks working UDP; HTTP/WebSocket and multiplayer core stay.

upnp.limit: No UPNP classes. Fixed web build already omits miniupnpc; do not promise substantial size savings.

scope: Explicit full or bounded conservative profile only; declarations are not proof of dynamic dependency absence. No arbitrary module overrides or class trimming. Neither profile grants device acceptance.
